async def act(page):
    import asyncio
    # Navigate to Issues dashboard using the specific link in 'Your work' complementary section
    issues_link = page.get_by_role('complementary', name='Your work').get_by_role('link', name='Issues')
    await issues_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    await asyncio.sleep(2)  # Wait for page to load fully
    # Find search box to filter issues by 'better'
    search_box = page.get_by_role('searchbox').first
    await search_box.fill('better')
    await search_box.press('Enter')
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    await asyncio.sleep(2)  # Wait for results to load
    # Sort by last updated
    sort_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Sort', exact=False).first
    await sort_button.click()
    last_updated_option = page.get_by_role('menuitem', name='Last updated', exact=True).first
    await last_updated_option.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    await asyncio.sleep(2)  # Wait for sorting to apply
    # Click on the first issue with 'better' in title
    first_issue_link = page.get_by_role('link').filter(has_text='better').first
    await first_issue_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    await asyncio.sleep(2)  # Wait for issue page to load
    # Check if issue is closed by looking for status text
    status_element = page.get_by_role('status').or_(page.get_by_role('alert')).first
    status_text = await status_element.text_content()
    print(status_text)
